name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-UAV
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for camera-equipped UAVs: a named high-level flight-request vocabulary (PRE_FLIGHT_CHECK/TAKEOFF/GOTO_WAYPOINT/HOVER_AND_CAPTURE/RETURN_TO_LAUNCH) gated through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety contract, plus a real, deterministic HeartbeatMonitor link-loss failsafe state machine (explicit `now`-driven, no real sleeps, fully unit-tested including its exact timeout boundary) - the required watchdog a UAV bridge needs per this project's own architecture note. Never computes flight control or stabilization itself, and this heartbeat signal is a coordination-layer concern, not a replacement for the flight controller's own independent link-loss failsafe. No real MAVLink/DJI OSDK transport adapter or physical UAV validated yet.
